subtitle: Gentle, mostly seated or supported routines. Monday to Friday, about 30 to 45 minutes a day.
safety: Check with the doctor before beginning or changing any exercise routine, or if medicines have changed.
Go at a pace where you can still talk in full sentences. Never hold your breath or strain.
Stop and rest if you feel dizzy, lightheaded, unusually short of breath, or notice a racing or irregular heartbeat that is worse than normal.
Call for an ambulance for chest pain or pressure, fainting, sudden weakness or trouble speaking.
Wear sturdy, non-slip shoes. Keep a firm chair or kitchen counter within reach, and have water nearby. Skip a day if feeling unwell.
restMessage: It is the weekend. Rest, or take an easy walk around the house or yard. The weekday plan is below.

days.name: Monday
days.note: Easy start to the week. All done sitting down.

tiles.title: Seated Mobility Workout
tiles.tip: Move slowly. Loosen the neck, shoulders, hips and ankles.

tiles.title: Chair Workout, All Seated
tiles.tip: Keep breathing steadily. Take a short sip of water between moves.

tiles.title: 10-Minute Chair Yoga
tiles.tip: Gentle stretches. Let the heart rate settle.

days.name: Tuesday
days.note: Stand next to a kitchen counter or a sturdy chair you can hold.

tiles.title: 5-Minute Indoor Walk
tiles.tip: Easy pace. Walk in place near a counter if needed.

tiles.title: 10-Minute Balance Exercises
tiles.tip: Hold on with one hand whenever it feels wobbly.

days.name: Wednesday
days.note: Steady, low-impact walking is great for the heart. Keep it conversational.

tiles.title: Gentle Chair Exercises for Range of Motion
tiles.tip: Wake up the joints before walking.

tiles.title: 20-Minute Gentle Walking Workout
tiles.tip: Rest on a chair any time. Slow down if breathing gets heavy.

tiles.title: 15-Minute Gentle Chair Yoga
tiles.tip: Stretch calves, hips and back. Move slowly.

days.name: Thursday
days.note: Slow, flowing movement that helps balance and calm.

tiles.title: 10-Minute Chair Exercises
tiles.tip: Easy joint warm-up before the flow.

tiles.title: 15-Minute Chair Tai Chi
tiles.tip: Follow slowly. Smooth breathing, no rushing.

days.name: Friday
days.note: A mix of the week. Finish strong and feel good heading into the weekend.

tiles.title: Beginner Chair Exercises, No Equipment
tiles.tip: No weights needed. Smooth, controlled moves.

tiles.title: 7 Balance Exercises by Physical Therapists
tiles.tip: Hold the counter. Safety matters more than perfect form.

tiles.title: Chair Tai Chi for Mobility & Calm
